description: This file defines the ReflectionCallable class in the Twig Util namespace, which provides mechanisms to reflect on callables within the Twig templating engine, determining their properties and method information.

classes.name: ReflectionCallable
classes.description: Final class providing reflection and callable introspection capabilities for Twig callables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ReflectionCallable object, determining the nature of the callable and setting up reflection accordingly.

methods.name: getReflector
methods.description: Returns the ReflectionMethod or ReflectionFunction object representing the callable.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the callable associated with this reflection.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a string name representing the callable, e.g., class::method or 'Closure'.
